Collect the seller listing and option text that existed when you paid. An edited listing may no longer show the exact version supplied under your purchase.
corrections.translation: 查卖家订单本身的状态。已经向卖家采购，不代表一定已有快递号；仓库列表为空，也可能只是商品正在国内运输。保存已知的下单信息与快递记录，EastMallBuy 在这一步也会参考商家及所在平台的条件。请代理核实取消、拦截或到仓后寄回分别还来不来得及。

corrections.source: Explain the reason for your request in terms that can be checked. “I chose charcoal and now prefer beige” and “I selected charcoal but the seller confirmed beige” suggest different conversations with the merchant. Include the selection or message that establishes the difference. Ask for the seller's reply and what must happen next. An agent's acknowledgment that the question was sent is a progress update. An actual seller agreement should identify the item, the requested resolution and any conditions attached to it.
corrections.translation: 用能核实的事实说明原因。“我原选炭灰色，现在想改米色”与“我选了炭灰色，卖家的确认却写米色”涉及不同情况。前者是个人选择改变，后者需要对照确认记录。把原选项、卖家答复和你愿意接受的处理方式放在同一条消息里。

corrections.source: A warehouse entry gives you evidence that did not exist when the item was still with the seller. Link the entry to the order number and inspect the supplied photographs. Save the most informative view and an overview that identifies the unit. If the issue is a size mismatch, a photo of the attached size label may be enough to ask a focused question. If you believe a bag strap is missing, ask whether it was packed inside the bag before treating the omission from a photograph as proof.
corrections.translation: 入库后可以查看仓库实物照片、包装和标签，这些是此前缺少的证据。将入库编号关联采购单，保存能看出问题的照片，再留一张显示整件商品的全图。若仍无法确认颜色、款号或缺件，请只补查与决定有关的细节。

corrections.source: Decide what you need done while the item is physically available. Request a check or return before including it in the next parcel. Keep the seller's original packaging if it may be required and ask about domestic return postage. Open the current policy and order-specific terms as soon as the issue appears. Do not use the length of the warehouse storage period as a calendar for making a return decision. Storage, merchant acceptance and an individual after-sales request each concern a different action.
corrections.translation: 只要实物还在仓库，就先明确是要查验还是退货，并在提交下一票国际包裹前处理。可能要退的商品先留原包装，询问国内退回运费、卖家期限及所需授权。若另有物品可以正常出库，在清单上分别标出。

corrections.source: Find the waybill number as well as the purchase number. A waybill can exist before a parcel leaves. Conversely, an older screen can make a parcel look as though it is still editable after packing has progressed. Ask specifically whether dispatch can still be stopped and whether the particular item can be removed. If the request affects only the jacket, give its warehouse entry and say what should happen to the unaffected bag. Do not assume a change to the product order will automatically stop the parcel.
corrections.translation: 同时找到采购编号和国际运单号。创建运单不等于货已实际出境；较旧的页面也可能让已经进入打包的货看似还能修改。联系仓库查询目前能否暂停、移出指定物品，以及已发生的费用。得到确认前不要推定指示已经执行。

corrections.source: Work through the cost implications of the proposed change. The product amount belongs to the seller transaction. Outbound freight belongs to the international shipment. A warehouse service already performed is a third line. Even when staff can stop a parcel, the amounts associated with those lines can be treated differently. Ask for the breakdown in writing. The old estimate for a parcel containing two items may also need updating if one is removed and the packing changes.
corrections.translation: 把收费分为卖家交易中的货款、国际包裹运费和已完成的仓库服务费。撤回一件商品，未必意味着其余费用按相同比例减少。向代理逐项确认哪些可退、哪些需重新报价，以及是否需要改用另一包装或线路。

corrections.source: Make a short reconciliation record with four fields: original charge, expected refund, actual credit and destination. Record currency as well as amount. A quote given in yuan and a card statement in euros cannot be compared as bare numbers. Keep the reference for each transaction and check whether the case concerns a merchant refund, return postage or a separate withdrawal of an account balance. These may appear in different places and on different days.
corrections.translation: 退款核对可以用四栏：原扣款、预计退款、实际到账、到账去向。每项标金额与币种。人民币报价与欧元银行卡流水不能直接做减法，应查交易换算和记录。退款到平台余额，也不能仅因银行卡没变化就判定未退。

corrections.source: A resolved case should answer three questions. What happened to the physical unit? What amount went where? What can the warehouse now do with the remaining products? If the seller accepted an exchange, wait for a replacement identifier or incoming unit and check its option again. If the order was cancelled, keep the confirmation with the payment record. If a combined parcel had to be reopened, review its revised contents before authorizing shipment. Archive the original evidence once you have an outcome for each item.
corrections.translation: 结案前回答三个问题：原商品去了哪里，钱退到哪个账户、金额多少，剩下的物品现在能怎样处理？若卖家同意换货，要等替换件及其费用另有记录；若取消采购，则查清取消成功和退款是两个分别需要确认的节点。

corrections.source: There is value in writing a short case summary even for a small purchase. “Wrong colour found before seller dispatch; merchant cancellation confirmed; expected credit recorded; bag remains in warehouse” contains more usable information than a folder of unexplained screenshots. Someone reading your message can identify the next action without reconstructing an entire chat history. If facts change, revise the stage and the affected references first, then consult the part of EastMallBuy's live policy that applies to that new situation.
corrections.translation: 小额订单也值得留一条简明摘要。例如：“卖家发货前发现颜色问题；商家确认取消；已记录预计退款；包仍在仓库。”之后若余额或入库状态有变化，用这句话能迅速找到仍待核实的一项，再查新阶段适用的 EastMallBuy 政策。

corrections.source: If the order contains a matching pair, clarify whether the seller expects the entire pair back. Sending only the visibly defective piece might leave the return incomplete. Ask the agent to record the required quantity and any included accessories before a domestic return label is used. This also gives you a count to check against the eventual settlement.
corrections.translation: 若商品是成对出售，先问卖家要求整对退回，还是可仅寄回有缺陷的一只。只寄出明显坏的那件可能让退件不完整。请代理写明所需数量、配件和包装，再交给仓库执行，并保留最终退货清单。

corrections.source: Make your own packing list from the warehouse entries you intend to submit. Include order reference, unit, option, quantity and whether each item has completed the checks you need. If one piece is awaiting a size confirmation or seller reply, leave it explicitly marked as pending. A parcel record can appear complete while containing an unresolved item. Equally, a shipment of several items may accidentally leave behind a small accessory if its warehouse entry is easy to overlook.
corrections.translation: 以准备提交的入库记录为基础自制装箱单，列订单、实物、规格、数量和验货状态。某件仍待核实尺码或换货，就将它标为暂缓，别因它在同一仓库就默认装箱。下达打包指令之前再按清单逐一对照。

corrections.source: Imagine a parcel containing two folded shirts, a pair of shoes with a retail box and a small ceramic pin. The decision is not simply whether four purchase lines appear. Confirm that both shirts have the correct labels, the shoes form one matched pair and the pin is included as a physical component. If the pin came packed inside one of the shoe boxes, decide where it should be during international transport. A small item hidden inside another package can be both overlooked during inspection and vulnerable to contact damage.
corrections.translation: 例如两件折叠衬衫、一双带原盒的鞋和一枚陶瓷胸针。采购页上出现几条明细，并不能证明箱内全部正确。确认两件衬衫标签分别正确、鞋盒是需要保留的那层、胸针确实已随货准备好。小件应有可以与入库记录对应的证据。

corrections.source: Describe the risk you are trying to control. For the shirts, moisture or transfer of colour may matter. For the shoes, crushing or deformation may matter. For the ceramic pin, impact or pressure on a small point may matter. Explain how the objects should be separated if one can damage another. A generic request for “extra protection” leaves the packer deciding whether the priority is stiffness, cushioning, waterproofing or minimizing empty space. Different priorities can imply different packing materials.
corrections.translation: 不同物品需要不同防护。衬衫可能要防潮或避免染色，鞋要防压和变形，陶瓷胸针则要避免硬物撞击。给出具体风险，仓库才好说明现有包装是否足够、需要增加哪一层。笼统地要求“多包几层”无法说明最担心哪里。

corrections.source: Be clear about seller packaging. Keep a retail box if the box itself matters or helps protect the item. If you would accept folding or removing a layer, state exactly which one and check any open return conditions first. A request to remove “all packaging” could remove tags, inserts or protective sleeves you intended to retain. Ask which service is available for this parcel and what it changes. A service's name alone may not explain which components it affects or whether its effect is reversible.
corrections.translation: 说明卖家包装哪些必须保留。鞋盒本身有用途或能保护商品时，可要求保留；若允许折叠或去掉某一层，就点名是哪一层。商品仍可能退货时，先查卖家是否要求原包装完整。相同的“留盒”指令对不同商品未必意味着同样的安排。

corrections.source: An open-carton photograph, if available, can answer useful questions about arrangement. It may show the shoe box beneath another item, the pin wrapped separately or a gap that lets contents move. A closed-carton photograph answers different questions about the outside, visible sealing and carton condition. Decide which view supports the concern you have. A closed box with clean tape cannot establish that a specific shirt or small pin is inside, however reassuring the external appearance looks.
corrections.translation: 若能看到封箱前的照片，留意硬物是否顶着面料、鞋盒是否直接压在易碎件上，以及还有没有明显空隙会让物品滑动。照片能说明画面可见的摆放情况，却不一定能看到底层或验证所有防护。要针对可见风险问具体问题。

corrections.source: If an open view shows only the top layer, do not claim the lower layer is missing. Compare the warehouse entries and packing list, then ask about the specific unseen item. For the pin, useful evidence might be a picture of the wrapped pin next to its labelled pouch before the pouch enters the carton. If such a check is not available, keep that limitation in your records and decide whether the packing arrangement is adequate. Avoid asking the warehouse to unpack a sealed parcel unless the unresolved issue justifies it.
corrections.translation: 俯拍只见上层时，不能据此断言下面的物品没装。请将照片与逐项装箱记录对照，指出哪一件缺少可核实的证据。若开箱复核会产生额外费用或影响出库时间，应先请仓库说明选择，让你决定是否需要进一步检查。

corrections.source: Read the external length, width, height and scale weight associated with the current packing arrangement. If you authorized a different carton or removed the shoe box, figures recorded before that change may be stale. EastMallBuy's freight help explains that dimensional weight can affect a charge. Use the current route's conditions and the measured completed parcel, not measurements of individual seller boxes or an estimate copied from a different destination. Keep units visible and record the time of the quote.
corrections.translation: 核对当前包装对应的外部长宽高和秤重。若后来换了箱子或去掉了鞋盒，改动前的尺寸可能已不适用。把旧估算与新封箱值注明日期和单位，EastMallBuy 的运费说明提示体积重会影响费用；再查所选线路如何计算体积重，避免误用旧数据申请或比较报价。

corrections.source: Check eligibility separately from cost. An inexpensive route can have restrictions involving dimensions or contents that make it unsuitable for this parcel. If a particular item would require splitting the shipment, obtain comparable quotes for the split arrangement before assuming the lower route price saves money overall. Compare the actual destinations, packing options and services. A valid comparison includes both parcels if two are required and includes the packing protection you have decided to retain, even if that produces a higher total.
corrections.translation: 价格和能否承运应分开检查。即使某线路显示便宜，也可能限单边尺寸、限制特定内容或要求特殊包装。先用实际物品、目的地、尺寸及重量确认符合线路条件，再比较总价；不满足收件要求的报价不能当成可直接使用的方案。

corrections.source: Check the recipient and destination in the actual submission screen. Confirm the address, postal code and contact information privately in the service, particularly if your account contains more than one saved destination. Ensure the selected route corresponds to that destination and to the packing assumptions in your quote. Do not paste private address details into public photo-review groups when asking an unrelated question about carton protection. A cropped view or a simple description of dimensions can be sufficient for that discussion.
corrections.translation: 在实际提交页面核对收件人、地址、邮区和目的地。购买记录里的商品没有变，出库信息仍可能填错。将必要改动通过平台指定的私密渠道提交，确认最终页面显示的是本次要用的资料，避免在公开照片里传播完整面单。

corrections.source: Read any special instructions from the perspective of a packer handling several similar items. “Keep this box” is ambiguous if the order has two cartons. “Keep the shoe retail box for warehouse entry A; remove only the plain outer seller shipping carton for entry B” provides a usable mapping. If you revise the instructions, identify the replacement version and ask whether packing has already started. Adding a second conflicting instruction without withdrawing the first can create precisely the uncertainty you wanted the note to resolve.
corrections.translation: 站在要同时处理多个相似物件的仓库人员角度重读备注。有两个盒子时，只写“保留这个盒子”不够；可以写“保留入库记录 A 对应的鞋盒，普通卖家运输箱可拆”。要保留、压平和去掉的物品分别指明，再看备注是否互相矛盾。

corrections.source: Creating a waybill and physically dispatching a parcel are different events. EastMallBuy's policy treats the period before international dispatch separately from the period after it. If you notice a problem, give support the waybill reference and explain the requested change immediately. Ask whether the parcel can still be stopped or amended, what service has already been performed and whether the estimate must be revised. Do not assume an uncollected or unscanned tracking number proves that packing can still be reversed.
corrections.translation: 生成运单和包裹真正出库是两个节点。EastMallBuy 的规则区分国际寄出前后。若发现异常，立刻带运单号和入库编号联系代理，问清现在还能改什么，再得到暂停确认。不要把页面仍可查看误认为包裹必然还可以编辑。

corrections.source: Suppose the ceramic pin is discovered to be missing from the intended set just after parcel submission. Your request should say whether you want the whole parcel held, the pin checked or the unaffected items dispatched without it. Ask which option remains physically possible and how it affects charges. Save the answer and the actual outcome. A product-level discussion about replacing the pin does not automatically suspend an international waybill that has already entered processing.
corrections.translation: 假设提交后发现陶瓷胸针没有列入预计内容，先说明希望暂停整票、只查胸针，还是接受其余物品先寄。请仓库核对它是否仍在原入库位置，以及能否在当前打包阶段变更。只有收到确认后，才能把新的装箱方案当作已执行。

corrections.source: Before considering the parcel ready, keep the accepted packing list, final instructions, route, dimensions, weight, amount and waybill number together. Record any item intentionally left behind. Save relevant pictures of condition and protection, separating seller or warehouse reference photos from pictures of this actual packed parcel. A later support inquiry is easier when you can point to one outbound reference and identify the individual unit inside it.
corrections.translation: 放行前保存确认的装箱清单、最终备注、线路、尺寸、实重、金额和运单号，标明任何有意留仓的物品。把相关照片与对应记录放在一起。收到货后如发现异常，能据此区分原本没计划寄出的东西与实际到货差异。

corrections.source: At delivery, compare the package and contents with that record before disposing of packaging, especially if you see damage or missing pieces. Follow the current carrier and EastMallBuy reporting instructions for the situation. A good pre-dispatch review cannot guarantee safe delivery, but it makes three important facts recoverable: what you authorized to travel, which protection you asked for and what the warehouse actually documented. Those facts are useful whether the parcel arrives perfectly or needs an after-sales investigation.
corrections.translation: 签收时先将外箱与内容逐项对照出库记录，再处理包装。若发现损坏或缺件，按当前承运商及 EastMallBuy 的报备要求保存图片、面单和包装，留意时限。记录只写能够确认的事实，不凭一张外观照片断定由谁造成。

corrections.source: A useful final message describes the receiving end as well. If the recipient needs to identify two wrapped gifts separately, ask whether removable outer labels can distinguish them without marking the retail boxes. Use short descriptions that still make sense to someone who never saw the shopping cart. A label identifying the blue ceramic mug and another identifying the cream mug will remain meaningful after the warehouse reference numbers have been covered by protective wrapping.
corrections.translation: 收件人的实际需要也可以写进最终要求。比如两件已经包装好的礼物要分得出来，可问能否用可移除的外标签区分，同时不在商品盒上留下记号。说明标签应贴在哪一层、如何对应商品，再确认不与原包装保留要求冲突。

corrections.source: Begin with the line on the paid order. Suppose you ordered a navy zip jacket in medium, the seller sent black, and you would accept navy in the same size. Your change request should identify the item reference, the option ordered, the option received and the exact replacement you would accept. If you ask for “the right one,” everyone handling the case must recover the original context before making a decision. If you say “any navy is fine,” you may accidentally accept a different model or fabric.
corrections.translation: 从已付款明细开始。例如原订藏青色 M 码拉链外套，卖家发来黑色，买家愿换同尺码藏青色。请求中应写商品编号、收到的颜色与尺码、拟退回哪件、希望替换成哪一规格。这样对方不会把“换颜色”误解为同时换尺码或换款。

corrections.source: There is another important possibility. You received the navy medium as ordered but would now prefer a large. That is a different reason for an exchange. Describe it accurately. EastMallBuy's published policy distinguishes stages of a purchase and directs the buyer to merchant or marketplace conditions for a number of return decisions. The reason and timing can matter to the discussion of costs. A precise statement helps the agent present the actual case rather than a stronger-sounding complaint you cannot support with evidence.
corrections.translation: 另一种情况是本来就正确收到藏青 M，现在自己希望换 L。真实说明是偏好改变，与卖家发错货应该分别处理。EastMallBuy 按订单阶段说明可用流程，同时还需问卖家是否接受这类换码以及谁承担邮费。

corrections.source: A conversation can contain several confirmations that look alike. The agent may confirm that your message was received. The warehouse may confirm that the jacket is still available. The merchant may confirm stock of the navy medium. None of those individual statements necessarily establishes that the merchant agreed to take back the wrong unit on the terms you expect. Keep the question and the relevant reply together, including any wording that limits the answer.
corrections.translation: 聊天里“收到了”可能有几种意思。代理可以确认收到消息，仓库可以确认衣物还在，商家可以确认有货，真正同意换货的则是另一项决定。保留谁回复、回复的原文和对应问题，尤其不要把库存答复当成已经授权退回。

corrections.source: For example, a reply saying “medium available” answers a stock question. “Return this black medium with its tags; we can exchange it for the navy medium from this listing” identifies a physical return and a proposed replacement. Even this second reply may leave the deadline and domestic postage unresolved. Use it as evidence for the portions it actually answers. If translation makes the reply ambiguous, preserve the original text and ask the agent to clarify the unresolved point before instructing anyone to send the jacket away.
corrections.translation: “M 码有货”只回答库存；“请把带吊牌的黑色 M 寄回，我们可换此链接的藏青 M”才较清楚地说明退件与替换款。若费用、时限或替换款具体选项仍未写明，应接着单独确认，而不是自行补全对方没有答应的条件。

corrections.source: Write down the replacement listing identifier and variant wording. If the replacement comes from the same listing, compare all selectors rather than just the one you intend to change. A colour change might reset the size or alter the material options. If the merchant proposes another listing, open it and check model, construction, quantity, size chart and price. A similar studio image offers little protection against accepting an entirely different version of the jacket.
corrections.translation: 记录替换款商品编号和选项原文。同一链接下改颜色时，尺码、包装数量等其他选择可能自动重置，所以每个选项都要再看一次。若替换款来自另一链接，就当成一项新报价，核实款号、材质和所含附件，而非默认只有颜色有变。

corrections.source: Make a small acceptance record with an “existing unit” row and a “replacement unit” row. Both should state marketplace, seller, listing, colour, size and units included. Record an unknown value as a question rather than copying it across automatically. In our example the replacement must be navy, medium, single jacket, same model and same fabric. If the seller instead offers a navy large because medium sold out, the form makes the proposed substitution obvious and gives you a clear decision to make.
corrections.translation: 做两行对照：“当前商品”和“将收到的替换商品”。每行都写平台、店铺、商品编号、颜色、尺码和包含的件数。未知项目先标问号，不把预想填成确认。让代理或卖家用同一组信息确认，之后仓库也能依此验替换件。

corrections.source: Ask what the merchant expects to receive. For a jacket that might include the item, attached tags, removable belt and seller packaging. For a set it might be the complete set even if only one component is disputed. Separate the seller's retail packaging from the warehouse's international shipping carton. When the seller requests “original box,” ask which one is meant if more than one box exists. Photograph the return contents together before sealing where the available service permits.
corrections.translation: 先问商家要求收回什么。外套可能连同原吊牌、可拆腰带和商品包装退回；套装则可能要整套返还，即便争议只涉及一个部件。请仓库按明确清单准备退件，留下内容与包装照片，避免卖家收件后表示少了配件。

corrections.source: Next identify the effective deadline and the action that satisfies it. A requirement to open a case by a date differs from one to dispatch a return or have the merchant receive it by that date. Do not infer the requirement from a calendar reminder alone. Save the seller or platform wording, its time zone if stated and the last confirmed action. If the timeline is short, ask for an immediate answer about eligibility while the item is still in the warehouse.
corrections.translation: 留意期限约束的是提出申请、寄出退件还是卖家签收。三者是不同节点。同一天若指的是卖家收到，留给仓库实际寄出的时间可能更短。不要靠自己的估算替代条款，应请代理或卖家写清所需动作和相应截止时间。

corrections.source: Create separate entries for the old item amount, new item amount, domestic return charge and any reshipment or handling charge that is actually quoted. Ask who pays each amount and when. Do not enter an anticipated seller reimbursement as money already received. If the replacement costs more, specify whether you approve the difference and the currency. If it costs less, ask how the difference will appear. Keep the agent's answer next to the originally agreed figures.
corrections.translation: 把原货款、新货款、国内寄回运费及对方实际报出的重寄或处理费逐项分列，标明每笔谁先付、约定何时结算。卖家承诺稍后补贴的邮费，在它真实到账前仍属于待报销项目。保存对应的聊天和交易记录。

corrections.source: When the item moves, keep the outgoing domestic tracking record attached to the old unit. Save the warehouse release date and any receipt or merchant acknowledgment. If a replacement is dispatched, attach its tracking number to the new unit. Reusing a single generic field called “tracking” causes problems when both shipments are in progress. A delivered scan on the return can mean the seller has received the old piece, while your replacement has not yet left their shop.
corrections.translation: 旧件寄回时，将国内退件单号挂在旧商品记录下，记出库日期和商家签收情况。替换件寄出后，用新的跟踪号链接替换记录。把两个方向的单号分开，避免将“卖家已经收到旧件”看成“仓库已经收到新件”。

corrections.source: Plan for an interruption. What if the seller approves an exchange, receives the return and then reports that the navy medium is unavailable? Retrieve the accepted replacement description and any contingency agreed earlier. Decide whether you prefer a refund, a fresh wait for stock or another specifically identified option. Make the new choice explicit. A warehouse team that knows you agreed to one alternative should not have to guess whether you will accept a second, materially different proposal.
corrections.translation: 也要考虑中途缺货。比如卖家先同意换藏青 M，收到旧件后才发现该规格没货。此时调出已经接受的替换描述和预先约定的处理办法。如未授权其他颜色、退款或等待补货，应请代理重新确认，不能让黑色、其他尺码或相似款自动替代。

corrections.source: Match the replacement warehouse entry to its order or exchange reference. Compare the new photographs with your replacement row. Check the changed feature first, then make sure features that were supposed to remain the same still match. In our example that means checking the navy colour and medium label on the same unit and verifying that the jacket still uses the agreed zip and fabric. A picture inherited from the old warehouse entry cannot answer those questions about the replacement.
corrections.translation: 把替换件的新入库记录与原换货编号关联。先检查这次要求修改的颜色或尺码，再核对本该维持不变的款号、件数和附件。若又有差异，就用新照片和双方确认过的替换规格提问，而非只转发第一次的商品图。

corrections.source: Finish by checking the financial side as well. Mark outstanding postage, top-up or credit entries as settled only when you can identify their transaction records. Your final case note can be brief: black medium returned under the recorded domestic number; seller acknowledged receipt; navy medium arrived under a new warehouse reference; replacement checked; agreed difference posted. A note like this resolves both the movement of goods and the movement of money. It also leaves the correct unit ready to include in your later international parcel.
corrections.translation: 最后核对资金。邮费、补差价和待退款等项目，只有找到相应交易记录后才标作已结清。结案摘要可以很短，写清原件退回结果、替换件实收规格和仍有无未结金额即可。商品到了，不代表所承诺的报销也已经到账。

corrections.source: When two options look similar, preserve the exact seller wording for the replacement. A message agreeing to send a darker version can leave room for disagreement if the listing contains navy, charcoal and black. Ask the agent to repeat the replacement code or colour name back to you. Add that confirmation to the original purchase record so the second warehouse inspection checks the newly agreed variant, even if the first order line continues to show the original colour.
corrections.translation: 藏青、炭灰和黑色在照片里可能都显得很深。若只约定“寄深一点的版本”，收货后仍有争议空间。保留卖家原选项、色号和回复，说明到底是哪一种。验替换件时用同一套编号和描述，而不只凭屏幕上颜色深浅判断。

corrections.source: Take an illustrative order for a medium overshirt with a listed garment width of 58 centimetres. You plan to wear it over a sweatshirt. There are three separate tests: whether medium was supplied, whether the garment measures as the applicable chart describes, and whether that shape suits the way you plan to wear it. A photograph of a medium tag speaks to the first test. A tape measurement following the diagram speaks to the second. Trying a comparable garment over your sweatshirt helps with the third.
corrections.translation: 假设你订了一件 M 码外搭衬衫，尺码表标明衣服平铺宽 58 厘米，你想把它穿在卫衣外面。这里有三个问题：仓库收到的是不是 M 码？实物用商家规定的方法测量后，宽度是否符合尺码表？这个版型套在你的卫衣外面是否舒服？标签照能回答第一个问题，按示意图摆好尺子的照片能回答第二个问题。至于第三个问题，不妨先用自己的同类衣物试穿。

corrections.source: Suppose the warehouse reports 56 centimetres for the overshirt while the chart shows 58. Before interpreting the two-centimetre difference, check that both refer to the same size, style, unit and method. Read any tolerance specified by the seller rather than inventing one. If the endpoints are obscured, seek a clearer view. If the method is correct and the difference persists, present the chart and the measurement side by side. This gives the seller a concrete question to assess under the purchase terms.
corrections.translation: 假设仓库量出外搭衬衫宽 56 厘米，商家尺码表写的是 58 厘米。先核对是否为同一款、同一尺码、相同单位和相同量法，再判断这两厘米的差异。商家注明了误差范围，就按原文核对。照片若看不清尺子的起点或终点，请仓库补拍。确认量法无误后仍有偏差，可把尺码表和实测图并排发给卖家，请对方按交易条件处理。

corrections.source: Your current favourite overshirt might measure 61 centimetres across the chest. Even a perfectly supplied 58-centimetre garment could feel tight over the sweatshirt you intend to wear. That does not make the warehouse inspection wrong. Record the difference between your reference garment and the seller's stated dimensions, including the conditions of the measurement. A rigid woven fabric and a stretchy knit with the same flat width can also feel different when worn. A width comparison narrows the decision without guaranteeing comfort.
corrections.translation: 你常穿的外搭衬衫也许平铺胸宽 61 厘米。即便新衣完全符合商家所写的 58 厘米，套在卫衣外面仍可能偏紧。这种情况与仓库验货失误是两回事。记下参考衣物与商品尺码表的差值，并注明怎样量得。即使平铺宽度相同，硬挺的梭织布和有弹性的针织布也可能穿出不同效果。宽度能帮助筛选，舒适度还要结合穿法判断。

corrections.source: Consider an imaginary offer listing one organizer at 39 yuan and a three-piece set at 105. Buying quantity three of the single organizer yields three units for 117 before other costs. Buying quantity one of the set could yield three pieces for 105, but only if the set actually contains three organizers rather than one organizer and two accessories. Read the contents before comparing the arithmetic. A lower number attached to another unit is not a lower price for the same purchase.
corrections.translation: 举个虚构的例子：单只收纳袋卖 39 元，三件套卖 105 元。单只装数量选三，商品小计是 117 元，尚未计其他费用；三件套数量选一，商品小计是 105 元。但只有套装确实含三个收纳袋时才适合这样比较。若套装是一个袋加两个配件，购买内容已变。先读清单再算价，不能仅凭较低的小计判断哪项更便宜。

corrections.source: EastMallBuy's Help Center gives an example of a route using parcel dimensions in centimetres and a divisor of 8,000. The following numbers are invented to illustrate that arithmetic. They are neither an actual order nor a promise that a route uses this rule today. Suppose a carton measures 48 by 36 by 30 centimetres and weighs 5.4 kilograms with all contents and packaging. Its external volume is 51,840 cubic centimetres. Dividing by 8,000 produces a dimensional weight of 6.48 kilograms.
corrections.translation: EastMallBuy 帮助中心举过一个线路示例，用厘米计算包裹外尺寸，体积系数为 8,000。下面用虚构数字演示算法，实际下单请核对当前线路规则。假设封箱后长、宽、高分别为 48、36、30 厘米，连货物和包装共重 5.4 千克。外箱体积为 51,840 立方厘米，除以 8,000 后得到体积重 6.48 千克。

corrections.source: On a route charging the larger of actual and dimensional weight, the starting figure would be 6.48 kilograms before any billing increments or other rules. The parcel has not physically become heavier than 5.4 kilograms. Its box occupies enough space for the route's conversion to produce a larger billing input. Check the current route card to learn how that input is rounded and priced. Knowing the larger weight alone does not tell you the exact cash charge without the tariff and other applicable conditions.
corrections.translation: 假设这条线路在实重和体积重中取较大者，算出的起始计费重量就是 6.48 千克，尚未应用进位和其他计价规则。秤上仍是 5.4 千克，差异来自箱子占用的空间。下一步要看当前线路怎样进位、每个计费档多少钱。只有重量、没有运价和适用条件，还算不出最终支出。

corrections.source: Consider a revised packing proposal. The shoes retain their retail box and the jacket is folded differently, reducing the carton height from 30 to 25 centimetres while keeping length and width fixed. The new volume is 43,200 cubic centimetres and the example dimensional weight becomes 5.4 kilograms. If the physical weight is unchanged, actual and dimensional weight now coincide. The reduction of five centimetres removed 8,640 cubic centimetres, corresponding to 1.08 kilograms in this example.
corrections.translation: 第二种方案保留鞋盒，改用另一种方法折叠外套。长宽不变，箱高从 30 厘米降到 25 厘米。新体积是 43,200 立方厘米，按示例系数计算的体积重为 5.4 千克。如果实重未变，这时两种重量恰好相同。少了五厘米箱高，体积减少 8,640 立方厘米，相当于本例中的 1.08 千克体积重。

corrections.source: Those results give you a specific question for the warehouse. Can the contents fit within a height of 25 centimetres without crushing the shoes, damaging an insert or leaving a hard object pressing against fabric? Shrinking the carton only on paper does nothing. The calculation identifies an achievable target to investigate. If the smallest suitable carton is actually 28 centimetres tall, recalculate using 28. Keep the revised dimensions beside the estimate and ask whether the figures refer to the sealed exterior or the dimensions of an empty carton.
corrections.translation: 据此可以问仓库一个具体问题：箱高控制在 25 厘米以内时，鞋子会不会被压坏、内衬会不会变形、硬物会不会直接顶着面料？纸上缩小箱高并不会改变实物。若实际能用的最小箱子仍高 28 厘米，就按 28 重新算。把新尺寸与报价一起保存，并确认仓库给的是封箱后的外尺寸，还是空箱标称尺寸。

corrections.source: For a fixed actual weight and divisor, there is a boundary volume. In the example, multiply 5.4 kilograms by 8,000 to get 43,200 cubic centimetres. At or below that volume, dimensional weight no longer exceeds actual weight under this assumed rule. With the same 48 by 36 footprint, divide 43,200 by 1,728 to find the 25-centimetre boundary height. This explains why a reduction from 30 to 25 centimetres can matter while further compression may offer diminishing freight benefit.
corrections.translation: 当实重和体积系数固定时，可算出分界体积。本例把 5.4 千克乘以 8,000，得到 43,200 立方厘米。按这里假设的规则，体积降到这一数值或以下时，体积重就不再高于实重。箱底仍为 48 × 36 厘米，底面积是 1,728 平方厘米。用 43,200 除以 1,728，分界高度为 25 厘米。从 30 厘米降到 25 厘米可能影响运费，再压低箱子则未必划算。

corrections.source: Suppose you could force the carton down to 22 centimetres. The dimensional calculation would give 4.752 kilograms, but a parcel still weighing 5.4 kilograms continues to be rated from at least its physical weight on this illustrative route. Compare that result with the cost and risk of more aggressive packing. If reducing height beyond the boundary compromises protection, the supposed saving may disappear before you even consider the possibility of damage. Check whether a separate size band or route limit changes the outcome before finalizing the choice.
corrections.translation: 即使能把箱高压到 22 厘米，换算出的体积重虽为 4.752 千克，秤上仍有 5.4 千克。按本例的线路规则，计费至少仍按实重。把这个结果与额外打包成本、货物受压的风险放在一起看。如果低于分界高度要牺牲防护，预想中的运费优势可能已经消失。确定方案前，再核对是否有独立的尺寸档位或线路限制。

corrections.source: Record any selected packing service separately from the freight calculation. The service might change dimensions, weight or both, but its price is an additional part of the total. Compare the combined amount for each proposal. If option A quotes 100 units of currency for transport and option B quotes 93 plus a nine-unit service, option B totals 102. These imaginary round numbers illustrate why the smaller transport charge need not produce a smaller final payment. Use the original quote currency throughout.
corrections.translation: 将另外选购的打包服务单列。它可能改变尺寸、重量或两者，但服务费也要算进总额。假设同一币种下，方案 A 运费为 100，方案 B 运费为 93，另收九个货币单位的服务费，后者合计 102。这些是假设数字：明细里运费较低，最终支付金额仍可能较高。比较时沿用原报价的币种。

corrections.source: When the warehouse provides the final record, compare the dimensions in the same orientation and units, then compare actual weight and route. A change from a 48-centimetre length to a 50-centimetre length may matter even if the scale reading is almost unchanged. Ask whether protecting a protruding part, keeping a retail box or switching outer cartons explains the difference. Send the original estimate and current packed figures together, identifying the one change you are trying to understand.
corrections.translation: 仓库给出最终数据后，把长、宽、高按相同方向和单位排列，再核对线路与实重。即便秤上读数几乎没变，长度从 48 厘米变成 50 厘米也可能影响运费。可以问是否为保护凸出的部件、保留商品盒或更换外箱才增加了长度。把原估算与封箱后的数据一起发给仓库，明确指出想核实的那一处变化。

corrections.source: Your final note should let someone reproduce the decision without seeing your shopping cart. List what was packed, what protection stayed, the measured exterior, actual weight, route and total quote. Mark any unknowns, such as the final billing increment, as questions for the live route information. For the example parcel, the important finding was that carton height controlled the larger billing weight above 25 centimetres. For another parcel, scale weight or a route eligibility limit may control the entire choice. The method stays useful because the answer comes from the measured package.
corrections.translation: 最终记录应足以让没看过购物车的人复核这次选择：包了哪些物品，保留了什么防护，封箱外尺寸、实重、线路和总报价各是多少。尚未明确的计费进位规则等，留作向当前线路核实的问题。本例中，箱高超过 25 厘米后，较大的计费重量由箱高决定；换一票货，决定因素也许是实重或线路收件限制。结论要回到眼前这个包裹的实测数据。

corrections.source: Consider a shoe label that lists several regional systems. A marking of 8 next to one system and 41 next to another may be part of one conversion printed by the manufacturer. Comparing an order for an unspecified “8” with the visible 41 establishes little until the ordered system is identified. Go back to the original option wording and seller chart. If the original selection did not name a system, explain this uncertainty instead of treating a plausible conversion found elsewhere as the seller's own chart.
corrections.translation: 同一张鞋标可能列出多个地区的尺码。一个尺码体系旁写 8，另一个旁写 41，可能是厂商印在同一标签上的对照关系。若下单时只写“8”而未指明体系，单看照片里的 41 还不能认定发错货。先查原始选项和卖家尺码表；选项本来就没写清楚时，应向卖家说明并核实，不能拿别处的换算表代替这家店的规格。

corrections.source: Use a fictional case to see the distinction. A presentation box occupies 28 by 20 by 10 centimetres, but a rigid item beside it already requires a parcel 30 centimetres tall. Removing the presentation box may create an internal gap without reducing the exterior at all. Conversely, a retail lid that sticks up just two centimetres above every other item might require a taller carton. Record the proposed external dimensions and packed weight for both versions. Ask for the route calculation applicable to the actual destination and contents.
corrections.translation: 假设一个展示盒长 28、宽 20、高 10 厘米，但旁边的硬质物品已经需要 30 厘米高的外箱。去掉展示盒可能只是腾出内部空隙，外箱尺寸一点也不变。反过来，如果某个商品盒盖比所有其他物品高出 2 厘米，就可能迫使仓库选更高的外箱。分别记下保留和去除时的外尺寸与封箱实重，再按实际目的地、物品和线路核算。

corrections.source: For an illustrative purchase of two units at 80 yuan each, returning one unit starts with an 80-yuan item value. It does not automatically establish either the final credit or a refund of half the full international parcel cost. Add any agreed postage or deduction only when the agent or merchant identifies it. If the expected credit is 72 yuan after an explained eight-yuan deduction, compare the final credit with 72 and keep the explanation beside it. These figures demonstrate the arithmetic and are unrelated to EastMallBuy's actual fees.
corrections.translation: 假设买了两件，每件 80 元，退其中一件时，该件商品价是 80 元。这并不能直接确定最终到账额，也不能据此要求退回国际包裹运费的一半。代理或卖家明确说明退货邮费、其他扣款后，再加入计算。如果对方说明扣八元、预计退回 72 元，收到退款后就与 72 元核对，并保留说明。数字只用于演算，与 EastMallBuy 实际收费无关。

corrections.source: Consider an invented example. The original item costs 120 yuan, the proposed replacement costs 128 and there is a quoted domestic return charge of nine yuan. Before any other conditions or reimbursement, approving those two additional amounts would imply 17 yuan of further cost. If the seller agrees to cover the nine yuan later, your initial outlay and eventual net cost may differ. Record both. These numbers illustrate reconciliation and do not represent EastMallBuy rates, seller policy or a guaranteed outcome.
corrections.translation: 举个虚构的换货例子：原商品 120 元，新选项 128 元，另报国内寄回运费九元。暂不考虑其他条件或报销，接受差价和运费意味着还要付 17 元。若卖家承诺之后报销九元，应分别记录先垫多少钱、报销后实际承担多少钱。这是核对方法的示例，不是 EastMallBuy 的费率、卖家条款或结果保证。
